description: WITHDRAWN. Superseded by graph-0016. An attachment is a fragment-IRI prov:Entity with format, SHA-256, title, licence and source; blank-node-free; the pattern's image is SVG. Plain literals carry ^^xsd:string in N-Quads (AGSC-05-31 form c).
note: added 2026-09-16 at rc.3 (DS-2); unreleased, may be edited in place until the rc.3 tag
reason: Withdrawn at 1.0.0-rc.6 (PUB-6 Q55a; D100). The `nquads` member is defined by `tests/vectors/README.md` as "the complete canonical N-Quads serialization of the vector's input", but this file's serialization carries only the seven attachment and hasAttachment lines: the item's own obligatory `rdf:type`, `skos:inScheme`, `skos:prefLabel` and `asc:kind` lines (AGSC-05-12, AGSC-05-17, AGSC-05-26) and the Bundle node of AGSC-05-03/05-26 are absent, so a port comparing the whole file against the rule fails while a port comparing a subset passes. The attachment case it proves is preserved and completed in graph-0016.
